ValidationRule.description: All ERP Ship to account must have a bill to account as parent from same site.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( CONTAINS( AccountGroup__r.Name , "SHIP-TO"), NOT(ISBLANK(Parent.Name)), NOT(CONTAINS(Parent.AccountGroup__r.Name, "BILL-TO")), TEXT(ERP_Site__c) <> TEXT(Parent.ERP_Site__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: ERP Ship to account must have a bill to account as parent from same site.
